mapper.select: /* Attd08Mapper.selectAttdGpsTrail */ SELECT G.GPS_ID AS gpsId , G.LAT AS lat , G.LON AS lon , G.ACCURACY AS accuracy , G.API_CALL_DATE AS apiCallDate , G.API_CALL_TIME AS apiCallTime , G.IS_MOCKED AS isMocked , G.GPS_INFO_TYPE AS gpsInfoType FROM TB_USER_ATTD_GPS G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND G.ATTD_ID = #{attdId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT M WHERE M.ATTD_ID = #{attdId} AND M.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY G.GPS_INFO_TYPE ASC, G.API_CALL_DATE ASC, G.API_CALL_TIME ASC
